djangoFrameworkEntryAudit.reproduction: git clone --depth 1 --branch 5.2.5 https://github.com/django/django.git <temporary-directory>; scan with persistIdentity:false and cache:false

limitations: The external audit measures only manually audited exact outgoing static relationships in the declared scopes.
The Django audit measures only the narrow static management-command declaration subset.
This audit does not execute target applications, package commands, tests, servers, configuration, or runtime integrations.
This is not a general language-support score, runtime matrix, performance guarantee, or release approval.
